newsitem.title: PANAMA: Panama's stock exchange volume 50 pct up from 1995.
newsitem.headline: Panama's stock exchange volume 50 pct up from 1995.

text.p: Trading volume on Panama's budding stock market is expected to close this year more than 50 percent above 1995, Dulcidio de la Guardia, president of Panama's Brokers Association, said.
He told reporters the 11-share index was expected to reach a total trade of more than $350 million by the end of the year from $233 million in 1995, a 50.2 percent jump.
"The bolsa is growing because people understand it more and feel it is a reliable investment tool," he said.
